Cardiology: Heart and blood vessel disorders: chest pain, angina, heart attack, palpitations, arrhythmia, hypertension, heart failure, breathlessness with swollen legs.
Neurology: Brain, spinal cord and nerve disorders: stroke, paralysis, seizures, epilepsy, migraine, numbness, tremor, memory loss, head injury.
Orthopedics: Bones, joints and muscles: fractures, broken bones, joint pain, arthritis, back pain, disc problems, sports injuries, ligament tears, dislocation.
Pulmonology: Lung and breathing disorders: cough, pneumonia, asthma, wheezing, COPD, tuberculosis, low oxygen, breathlessness, sleep apnea.
Gastroenterology: Stomach, intestine and liver disorders: abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, acidity, jaundice, liver disease, gallstones, GI bleeding.
Nephrology: Kidney disorders: kidney failure, dialysis, creatinine, kidney stones, urinary infection, swelling with protein in urine, electrolyte imbalance.
General Medicine: General internal medicine: fever, infections, dengue, malaria, typhoid, diabetes, dehydration, weakness, fatigue, anaemia.
Pediatrics: Children and newborn care: fever in children, infant diarrhoea, newborn jaundice, premature baby, childhood infections, vaccination.
Obstetrics & Gynecology: Pregnancy, childbirth and women's health: labour, delivery, caesarean, pregnancy complications, menstrual problems, ovarian cysts.
Oncology: Cancer care: tumours, malignancy, chemotherapy, radiotherapy, biopsy, leukaemia, breast cancer, lung cancer, oral cancer.
ENT: Ear, nose and throat: tonsils, sore throat, sinusitis, blocked nose, hearing loss, ear infection, nosebleed.
Dermatology: Skin disorders: rashes, skin infection, cellulitis, psoriasis, eczema, allergic reactions, blisters, burns.
